info.name: Garmin Connect API
info.description:
REST API over garminconnect-go. Set the environment, run Account connection > Connect first.

Errors: {"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}.

item.name: Web session (cookie)
item.description: Browser-style login: Postman keeps the HttpOnly cookies between requests. No API key is sent.

request.description: Sets the session cookie, or mfa_pending + {mfa_required:true}. Rate limited to 5/min per IP.
Uses the mfa_pending cookie from Login.
Account of the session cookie.
Clears the session cookie; Garmin tokens stay stored.
Logs in to Garmin. Answers {connected, mfa_required}. When mfa_required is true, send the code to Connect MFA within 10 minutes.
Completes a login that returned mfa_required=true. A wrong code can be retried.
{connected:false} when the account has no stored tokens; otherwise display_name and full_name.
Deletes stored tokens and the cached client. 204.
date defaults to today (server time zone).
Negative value_ml subtracts. Max 10000 ml.
unit: kg or lbs (default kg). timestamp optional, RFC 3339; omitted = now.
weightPk comes from the Weigh-ins response; date is the weigh-in's day.
systolic 70-260, diastolic 40-150. pulse and timestamp optional.
No params = latest prediction.
type: daily or monthly. Range max one year.
type optional, e.g. running. Test script saves the first activityId.
format: original (zip), tcx, gpx, kml, csv. Use Send and Download.
Either field may be omitted. Returns the updated activity.
Multipart field 'file': a .fit, .gpx or .tcx file.
Permanently deletes the activity in Garmin Connect.
Body is Garmin's workout JSON, forwarded as is.
Any Garmin Connect API GET path; other query params are forwarded.
